name: Recruitment Pipeline Manager
description: End-to-end recruitment pipeline support. Screens CVs against role requirements, generates tailored interview questions for shortlisted candidates, and captures structured hiring decisions.

input_parameters.label: Role Title
input_parameters.placeholder: e.g., Senior AML Compliance Analyst, Head of Engineering

input_parameters.label: Key Role Requirements
input_parameters.placeholder: Essential and desirable requirements. Experience level, key skills, qualifications, soft skills, and any specific competencies.

input_parameters.label: CV / Application Batch
input_parameters.placeholder: Paste the CV content or application summaries for the candidates to screen. Use clear candidate separators (e.g., === CANDIDATE 1: John Smith ==).

steps.label: CV Screening & Scoring
steps.description: ANTON screens each CV against role requirements and produces a ranked shortlist.

config.promptTemplate:
Screen the following CVs for the {{role_title}} position.

Role requirements:
{{role_requirements}}

Candidates:
{{cv_batch}}

For each candidate produce:
- Overall score (1-10) with rationale
- Strengths matched to requirements
- Gaps or concerns
- Recommendation: Invite to interview / Hold / Reject
- 1-2 specific points requiring clarification

Produce a ranked shortlist summary at the end.

steps.label: Generate Interview Questions
steps.description: ANTON generates tailored, competency-based interview questions for shortlisted candidates.

config.promptTemplate:
Generate tailored interview questions for the {{role_title}} position.

Shortlisted candidates and their profiles:
{{step-0.output}}

Role requirements:
{{role_requirements}}

For each shortlisted candidate, produce:
1. 3-4 competency-based questions targeting their specific gaps or experience claims
2. 2 role-specific technical questions
3. 1 scenario question testing judgment

Also produce a standard question set (5-6 questions) applicable to all candidates.

steps.label: Hiring Manager Shortlist Decision
steps.description: Hiring manager reviews ANTON's screening and approves the interview shortlist.

config.checkpointMessage: Review the CV screening results and proposed shortlist. Approve, modify, or override the shortlist before interview invitations are sent.

inputFields.label: Shortlist approval
inputFields.placeholder:
Confirm who to invite. Example:
Invite: John Smith, Maria Garcia, David Chen
Hold: Sarah Wilson (rescreen if top 3 decline)
Reject: All others

Note any overrides to ANTON's recommendations with reasoning.

inputFields.label: Additional assessment requirements
inputFields.placeholder: Any specific topics, scenarios, or assessments to add to the interview process...
